# TestScript for 11-trailing-args-forwarding
# Asserts DashArgs (--) and RawArgs (bare unparsed args)

# 1. Test subcommand without DashArgs
exec trailing-args-forwarding test ./pkg/server
stdout '⚙  trailing-args-forwarding test'
stdout 'trailing-args-forwarding · root'
stdout 'test · active'
stdout '<pkg>\s+string\s+\./pkg/server\s+● cli'
stdout '\[-- <args\.\.\.>\]\s+DashArgs\s+—\s+○ unset'
stdout 'DashArgs container: \[\]'

# 2. Test subcommand with DashArgs forwarded after '--'
exec trailing-args-forwarding test ./pkg/server -- -v -run TestAuth -count 5
stdout '⚙  trailing-args-forwarding test'
stdout '\[-- <args\.\.\.>\]\s+DashArgs\s+-v -run TestAuth -count 5\s+● cli'
stdout 'DashArgs container: \[-v -run TestAuth -count 5\]'

# 3. Exec subcommand with bare unparsed arguments
exec trailing-args-forwarding exec my-container ls -la /var/log
stdout '⚙  trailing-args-forwarding exec'
stdout 'exec · active'
stdout '<container>\s+string\s+my-container\s+● cli'
stdout '\[args\.\.\.\]\s+RawArgs\s+ls -la /var/log\s+● cli'
stdout 'RawArgs container: \[ls -la /var/log\]'

# 4. Global flags mixed with raw container arguments
exec trailing-args-forwarding -v exec my-container python3 -m http.server 8000
stdout '<container>\s+string\s+my-container\s+● cli'
stdout '-v, --verbose\s+bool\s+true\s+● cli --verbose'
stdout '\[args\.\.\.\]\s+RawArgs\s+python3 -m http\.server 8000\s+● cli'

# 5. RawArgs swallows tokens that look like the app's own flags (no '--' needed)
exec trailing-args-forwarding exec my-container grep -v -r --include '*.go' TODO
stdout '\[args\.\.\.\]\s+RawArgs\s+grep -v -r --include \*\.go TODO\s+● cli'
